about:
# Select All High Detail
Just adds a "Select All High Detail" button to the Editor pause menu.
Clicking this button will select all High Detail Mode objects in the working level.

# Special Thanks
## Credits:
- [MalikHw47](https://youtube.com/@MalikHw47) - Mod dev
- [GDGamer69](https://www.youtube.com/@GDGamer-69) - Logo!

## Contributors:
- [TheRealIonIon](https://github.com/TheRealIonIon) - Notifications + button design + bug fixes
